options.content: Trade execution summary and macro PnL decomposition over the selected time range. Average fill prices are quantity-weighted. Wealth delta is decomposed into: Net Spread Capture (realized quoting edge), Inventory Drift (mark-to-market carry on held inventory), Adverse Selection (toxic flow slippage), and Exchange Fees. Identity: Total Wealth PnL = Net Spread Capture + Inventory Drift + Adverse Selection.

WITH latest_diagnostics AS (
  SELECT e.payload, e.exchange
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
role_exchanges AS (
  SELECT gates.key AS role_exchange,
         gates.value->>'role' AS role
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(d.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS gates
  UNION
  SELECT d.exchange AS role_exchange,
         'local' AS role
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
  WHERE d.exchange IS NOT NULL
),
fills AS (
  SELECT
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'fee', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'fee', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS fee
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND qty > 0) AS bid_qty,
    SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND qty > 0) AS ask_qty,
    SUM(fee) AS total_fee,
    SUM(price * qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0), 0.0) AS bid_avg_price,
    SUM(price * qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0), 0.0) AS ask_avg_price
  FROM fills
)
SELECT ($__timeTo())::timestamptz AS "time",
       COALESCE(bid_qty, 0.0) AS value
FROM agg

  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS total_mark_price
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
scope_rows AS (
  SELECT "time", 'local' AS metric,
         local_cash AS cash,
         local_inventory AS inventory,
         local_mark_price AS mark_price
  FROM state_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", 'global',
         global_cash,
         global_inventory,
         global_mark_price
  FROM state_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", 'total',
         (local_cash + global_cash),
         (local_inventory + global_inventory),
         total_mark_price
  FROM state_rows
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT "time",
         metric,
         cash,
         inventory,
         mark_price,
         LAG(cash) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS cash_prev,
         LAG(inventory) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS inventory_prev,
         LAG(mark_price) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS mark_price_prev
  FROM scope_rows
),
step_parts AS (
  SELECT "time",
         metric,
         (cash - cash_prev) AS delta_cash,
         (inventory - inventory_prev) AS delta_inventory,
         (mark_price - mark_price_prev) AS delta_price,
         inventory_prev,
         mark_price_prev
  FROM deltas
  WHERE cash_prev IS NOT NULL
    AND inventory_prev IS NOT NULL
    AND mark_price_prev IS NOT NULL
),
component_steps AS (
  SELECT "time", metric,
         (delta_cash + delta_inventory * mark_price_prev) AS net_spread_capture,
         (inventory_prev * delta_price) AS inventory_drift,
         (delta_inventory * delta_price) AS adverse_selection,
         ((delta_cash + delta_inventory * mark_price_prev) + (inventory_prev * delta_price) + (delta_inventory * delta_price)) AS total_wealth_delta
  FROM step_parts
)
SELECT "time", metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT "time",
         'Total Wealth PnL' AS metric,
         SUM(total_wealth_delta) OVER (
           ORDER BY "time"
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS value
  FROM component_steps
  WHERE metric = 'total'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time",
         'Net Spread Capture',
         SUM(net_spread_capture) OVER (
           ORDER BY "time"
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         )
  FROM component_steps
  WHERE metric = 'total'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time",
         'Inventory Drift',
         SUM(inventory_drift) OVER (
           ORDER BY "time"
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         )
  FROM component_steps
  WHERE metric = 'total'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time",
         'Adverse Selection',
         SUM(adverse_selection) OVER (
           ORDER BY "time"
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         )
  FROM component_steps
  WHERE metric = 'total'
) s
ORDER BY 1, 2
